# Methanation Reactor (MethanationReactor)

> **Class**: `MethanationReactor` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hydrogen` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Sabatier Power-to-Gas Methanation Reactor: CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O.

A fraction ``conversion_efficiency`` of the accepted H2 feed (capped at
``max_h2_feed_kg_hr``) reacts with stoichiometric CO2 (assumed available); the rest
leaves unreacted (``m_dot_H2_unreacted_kg_hr``, no recycle). The water by-product is
``m_dot_H2O_kg_hr``. Mass balance (kg/h):

    H2_fed + CO2_consumed == CH4 + H2O + H2_unreacted

Reaction heat is 165 kJ per mol CH4 (exothermic, at 25 degC). Stateless.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'Methanation'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `max_h2_feed_kg_hr` | `float` | `200.0` | kg/h | - |
| `conversion_efficiency` | `float` | `0.95` | - | Chemical conversion yield factor |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_H2_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_CH4_kg_hr` | kg/h | Synthetic natural gas production mass flow rate |
| `m_dot_CO2_consumed_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `Q_reaction_MW` | MW | - |
| `m_dot_H2_unreacted_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `m_dot_H2O_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `m_dot_H2_fed_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: steady state with a constant conversion_efficiency independent of load, temperature and
pressure; CO2 is assumed available; H2 feed up to max_h2_feed_kg_hr.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import MethanationReactor

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('methanationreactor', model=MethanationReactor(), outputs=['m_dot_CH4_kg_hr', 'm_dot_CO2_consumed_kg_hr', 'Q_reaction_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['methanationreactor'].tail(2))
```
